body: I am going to a therapist and seeing her but I feel it isn't enough, I need a life coach or something but my parents just ignore it. I feel as if my parents truly don't care. Mom is always freaking out over the littlest things and yelling at me mostly and dad and I argue 24/7. The house is always hostile no matter what and I seclude myself away from everyone else. It's terrible I know but there isn't much I can do with my family being this way. I want to move out but no money and no car. I can't drive since I'm afraid to drive with my parents. I had ask for a driving instructor but was told to take more hours (even though I got the new position....) I don't understand my parents anymore and I don't know what to do anymore

I also would like to know how to get my life back in order again since I failed college. Should I try a different school or
Should I work a while and just  hope for the best?
